headline: 4 people are waiting for your answer

lead.why: The trip is on Monday, and Maya can’t go without it.

waiting.subject: Friday dinner?
waiting.gist: Asks if you are all coming for dinner on Friday
waiting.short: Mom is cooking on Friday and wants to know if all four of you are coming, and if Maya still doesn't eat fish.
waiting.reply:
Hi Mom,

We'd love to come. All four of us, around [7pm]. And yes, still no fish for Maya.

Love,
Dana

waiting.subject: Science museum trip: form and lunch
waiting.gist: Needs the signed trip form by Friday
waiting.short: The class goes to the science museum on Monday. Ms. Alvarez needs the signed permission form by Friday, and asks if Maya will bring her own lunch.
waiting.reply:
Hi Ms. Alvarez,

Thank you. I'll send the signed form with Maya [tomorrow], and she will bring her own lunch.

Dana Cohen

waiting.subject: Cabin in October?
waiting.gist: Asks if you want to share a cabin in October
waiting.short: Noa found a lake cabin for the long weekend in October, big enough for both families. She needs to know by the weekend to book it.
waiting.reply:
Hi Noa,

That sounds lovely! Let me check with Ben tonight and I'll tell you by [Saturday].

Dana
